items.title: 为 StoryStore 的 story/bug/evidence 读写入口补 fixture 覆盖
items.context: 至少覆盖 readStory/writeStory/readBugs/writeBugs/readTestEvidence/writeTestEvidence 这 6 个入口，证明读写协议和默认值行为都可回归。

happy.desc: 给 6 个 StoryStore 入口补上 @test 后，gap_analyze 不再把它们列为 no_test。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:4 WHY happy case writes and re-reads story, bug, and test-evidence state through StoryStore, so the persisted protocol has a concrete round-trip assertion. severity=info

edge.desc: 读缺失 bug/test-evidence 文件时，仍保持当前默认值/空值回退行为。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:19 WHY edge case verifies missing bug.json and test-evidence.json still fall back to [] and null, matching the store probe behavior. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果只补 @test 注释但 fixture 文件不存在，gap_analyze 仍会继续报 fixture not found，而不是误判为已覆盖。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:29 WHY adversarial case rewrites @test to a missing fixture name and confirms gap_analyze still emits six fixture-not-found gaps instead of false coverage. severity=info

items.title: 补一条回归，锁住这组入口不再出现在 no_test backlog
items.context: 重点是让 gap_analyze 不再列出这 6 个函数缺 @test 注释，同时不破坏现有 StoryStore 协议。

happy.desc: 回归能证明这 6 个 StoryStore 入口不再出现在 no_test backlog。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:45 WHY regression happy path proves the live gap report no longer contains store-state no_test entries after this story lands. severity=info

edge.desc: 回归允许项目仍有其他 medium no_test 项，不会把整个 no_test 列表错误清空。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:58 WHY edge case injects an unrelated temporary missing fixture and confirms analyzer still reports that gap while keeping store-state entries cleared. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果以后移除了这组入口上的 @test 或 fixture 文件，回归会再次看到对应 no_test 项。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/store-state-entries.json:71 WHY adversarial case strips the six @test lines and confirms the corresponding no_test descriptions return, so the regression will catch coverage backslides. severity=info
